done_when: forge fix amend accepts --append '<text>' to add to the Done-when, and both --done and --append print the old and new text before writing; a test covers both on a new and an adopted repo, and the coordinator guide names --append

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Test. The test checks that the preview precedes the final success message, but never establishes that it precedes writing. Moving the preview in src/forge/task.py:592 after repo.commit_state at lines 600–601 would violate the explicit before-writing requirement while every assertion still passes for both options and both repository fixtures. Strengthen the command-level proof to detect persistence occurring before the preview.
findings.title: Gate: test_1_amend_preserves_done_when_on_append_and_previews_both_changes

why: forge fix amend --done replaces the whole Done-when, so a coordinator who meant to add a line wiped it (issue 973)
